summary: --agent no longer implies --yes, so inbound-plans writes need an explicit --yes (or --dry-run) even in agent mode.
reason: inbound-plans create/cancel/confirm already require --yes, but --agent set it silently, so any agent-mode call sent the FBA write with no confirmation step.
validated_outcome: go build, go vet, go test ./... pass; new test asserts --agent inbound-plans cancel and packing confirm fail with 'requires --yes'; verify_skill.py: 0 errors.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Printing Press >= 4.30.3 already emits --agent without --yes (cli-printing-press#4182); a reprint supersedes this patch.
deferred_to_upstream.reason: This CLI was printed under 3.10.0, before the generator fix.
